name: Merchant caravan wagon
description: Obchod F1 (#59): the merchant's own covered wagon with a draught horse (never the player's). Full on arrival, unloading at the marketplace, empty when leaving. Shown driving along grid x: like the player's carts (VehicleViews) the game mirrors one view for the other direction.

variants.name: Full wagon
variants.notes: Red canvas cover (unlike the player's carts) on hoops, crates, sacks and a barrel showing at the back.

variants.name: Unloading
variants.notes: Cover rolled forward, tailgate down, crates and a sack on the ground behind.

variants.name: Empty wagon
variants.notes: Bare hoops, one sack left: leaving the marketplace.
